task_description: Implement Batch 1 inventory-management features into the existing React + Vite + Express + PostgreSQL app: (1) SKU/barcode per product with a self-contained Code128-B SVG generator, (2) stock audit log via a stock_movements table with transactional writes and read routes + UI, (3) soft delete + archive/restore (+ admin permanent delete), (4) client-side CSV bulk import with preview backed by a transactional POST /api/products/bulk and SKU-extended export, (5) in-app low-stock notification bell. Backend first (shared foundation), then frontend. Schema changes idempotent; API response shapes preserved (only additive); parameterized SQL only; no e-commerce features; no email.
